crossRefs.note: When he saw that, he arose, and ran for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant…
But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested…
The same was in the beginning with God.
All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.
(although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),
he left Judea and departed into Galilee.
But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”
Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.
But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and…
Therefore I am full of Yahweh’s wrath. I am weary with holding it in. “Pour it out on the children in the street, and…
For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:
So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Yahweh’s hand was…
for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”
Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.
But when Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that…
For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about; for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t…
For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.
For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

translations.web: If I say, I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones. I am weary with holding it in. I can’t.
translations.bsb: If I say, “I will not mention Him or speak any more in His name,” His message becomes a fire burning in my heart, shut up in my bones, and I become weary of holding it in, and I cannot prevail.
